'''Stage I Dispatchers''' are a type of [[Mobs|Mob]], placed into the [[Nexus Parasites|Nexus]] Tier.

Killing one will grant the {{AdvancementLink|ZAYIN Suppression}}.

== ''Spawning'' ==
*Spawns by chance from a [[Dispatcher Nidus]] accumulating 40 kills from nearby parasites. 
**Can spawn naturally without the use of Nidi when [[Ubiquitous Development]] reaches level 3.
*If at least one [[Colony]] exists, spawns when a [[Stage II Dispatcher]] is killed.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Stage I Dispatchers are Stationary Offensive Support Parasites.
*Stage I Dispatchers can store and teleport parasites around using [[Dispatcher Tentacle|Dispatcher Tentacles]], Stage I Dispatchers can summon up to 3. Parasites that have been stored by a Dispatcher that despawn will end up back in the Dispatcher's storage.
*Stage I Dispatchers can summon up to 3 [[Seizer|Seizers]].
*Stage I Dispatchers will force nearby [[Assimilated Mobs]] to drop their disguise (unless if they are on water).
*Stage I Dispatchers throw 4 bombs around them when damaged, this has a cooldown of 5 seconds. The bombs inflict 3 damage each and place an effect cloud of stacking [[Viral]] and Poison.
*Stage I Dispatchers can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 3, with a 60 ticks cooldown and 1 Block range.
*Stage I Dispatchers will apply the following effects to parasites once they're stored:
**[[Debar]] I (1:40)
**[[Link]] I (3:20)
**[[Heightened Senses]] I (1:40)

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
*Stage I Dispatchers, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
**Any entities a Dispatcher summons will also be on fire.

* Right clicking on any of their Dispatcher Tentacles or Seizers will apply the glowing effect to their Dispatcher.

== ''Trivia'' ==
* Like all Nexuses, Stage I Dispatchers do not despawn by default.
* The Stage I Dispatcher's spawning sound is an electronically distorted violin screech.
* Dispatchers are known as '''Dod''' internally.
* Dispatchers were called "Reinforcers" in the early builds of [[Version 1.9.6|1.9.6]].
